Name: Flowery Tools
Author: CatCattyCat
Description:
[size=6]Flowery Tools
[size=3]
This mod makes unique flower patterns burst from your tools when you use them.
[/size][/size][list]
[*][size=6][size=3]Works in multiplayer: your friends will also see the flowers! You can disable this if you want - edit the config.json and set LocalOnly from false to true.[/size][/size]
[*][size=6][size=3]Compatible with Fast Animations (as long as you don't use a crazy high multiplier)![/size][/size]
[*][size=6][size=3]See the tools it affects and what it looks like here: [size=6][size=3][url=https://imgur.com/a/NGmbhVr]https://imgur.com/a/NGmbhVr[/url] or see images section[/size][/size]. A few examples are below.[/size][/size]
[/list][size=6][size=3][size=6][size=3][size=3][size=4]Requires SMAPI by Pathoschild.[/size][size=4]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files][size=5]Check out my other mods by clicking here![/size][/url][/size][/size][/size][/size]
